coordinateMeaning: Photographer position, never the building centroid. Full numerical source precision is retained; physical GPS accuracy is not guaranteed by this audit.
method: Inspect Commons camera versus object templates, compare camera templates to original EXIF GPS when available (maximum difference 1 m), exclude conflicting or uncertain points, and cross-check suspect building locations with the official Rutgers map.
